name: 耶鲁-布朗强迫量表
instructions: 以下问题涉及您最近的强迫思维和强迫行为。请根据过去一周的实际情况作答。
instructionsEn: The following questions concern your recent obsessive thoughts and compulsive behaviors. Please answer according to what actually happened over the past week.
license: Goodman 等编制，可免费用于非商业用途，使用时请注明出处。

items.text: 您花在强迫思维上的时间有多少？（过去一周）
items.textEn: How much time do you spend on obsessive thoughts? (over the past week)

items.text: 强迫思维对您的社交、工作或其他重要功能的影响程度如何？
items.textEn: How much do obsessive thoughts interfere with your social life, work, or other important activities?

items.text: 您因强迫思维而感到的痛苦程度如何？
items.textEn: How much distress do you feel because of obsessive thoughts?

items.text: 您对强迫思维的抵抗程度如何？
items.textEn: How much do you resist the obsessive thoughts?

items.text: 您对强迫思维的控制程度如何？
items.textEn: How much control do you have over the obsessive thoughts?

items.text: 您花在强迫行为上的时间有多少？（过去一周）
items.textEn: How much time do you spend on compulsive behaviors? (over the past week)

items.text: 强迫行为对您的社交、工作或其他重要功能的影响程度如何？
items.textEn: How much do compulsive behaviors interfere with your social life, work, or other important activities?

items.text: 当强迫行为被阻止时，您的焦虑程度如何？
items.textEn: How anxious would you feel if you were prevented from carrying out your compulsive behaviors?

items.text: 您对强迫行为的抵抗程度如何？
items.textEn: How much do you resist the compulsive behaviors?

items.text: 您对强迫行为的控制程度如何？
items.textEn: How much control do you have over the compulsive behaviors?

totalBands.description: 总分低于8，未达到临床强迫症状标准。
总分8-16，存在轻度强迫症状，建议关注。
总分16-24，存在中度强迫症状，建议寻求专业评估。
总分24-32，存在重度强迫症状，建议尽快寻求专业帮助。
总分32及以上，存在极重度强迫症状，请尽快寻求专业医疗帮助。
